description: Mendeley Data version 2 publishes three XLSX workbooks from a SWAT and AdH/PTM modelling study of the Upper Raba catchment and Dobczyce drinking-water reservoir in Poland. The files include catchment flow and sediment-load results, deposition coordinates and particle diameters, plus mapped clay, silt and organic-mineral sediment under baseline and climate and land-use scenarios. The repository gives CC BY 4.0 and free access. The article places the underlying period in 1991–2017 and the sediment comparison at monthly intervals. These outputs can benchmark reservoir-sedimentation and capacity-loss simulations. They are scenario results for one basin, not an executable copy of the SWAT or AdH/PTM models or a general sediment measurement network. Users should inspect the workbook sheet units, forcing assumptions and calibration before comparison. It complements data-grsr-global-reservoir-sedimentation-rate with detailed local spatial deposition. The workbooks were not downloaded. A limitation is that these model outputs depend on the study-specific calibration and scenario assumptions.
